title: Enterprise Agent Workspace Repository Graph Schema
description: Canonical schema definition for multi-project workspace topologies, repository directories, and verified architectural dependencies in PostgreSQL EAA_BASE.

$schema.description: URI to this JSON Schema definition

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when graph was exported or generated

projects.description: List of workspace repositories and codebases registered in the CMS

id.description: Unique identifier for the project workspace (e.g. proj-enterprise-agent)

name.description: Human-readable display name of the repository

repo_path.description: Filesystem path to the local repository directory

code_type.description: Primary programming language / tech stack of the repository

github_repo.description: Optional GitHub / remote git repository clone URL

output_dir.description: Directory for generated architectural models and fact sheets

metrics_dir.description: Directory for DuckDB/LanceDB forensic metrics sinks

last_scanned_at.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent directory scan

dataset_status.description: Status of dataset indexing and DuckDB readiness

position_x.description: X coordinate on the React Flow CMS canvas

position_y.description: Y coordinate on the React Flow CMS canvas

dependencies.description: Cross-repository architectural relationships and communication protocols

id.description: Unique identifier for the dependency connection

source_repo_id.description: ID of the source/caller project workspace

target_repo_id.description: ID of the target/callee project workspace

protocol.description: Protocol specification (e.g. REST / SSE JSON, JSON-RPC, FactSheet Metamodel)

description.description: Human explanation of the interaction contract

evidence_file.description: Source code file demonstrating the call site or import
